basis: The gallery has no entity of its own: its About page credits Petroliam Nasional Berhad as copyright holder and says it was founded in line with PETRONAS' commitment, and the PETRONAS media release of 7 August 2026 announces the gallery's relocation as PETRONAS news.

Subsidiary Legislation 595.29 (Legal Notice 308 of 2018 as amended by Legal Notice 205 of 2023) article 3 makes the Agency a body corporate, article 4 has the Minister appoint the Board, article 6(5) has the Minister appoint the Executive Head, and article 8(1) has the Agency appoint its own employees.
